> [!CAUTION] > Some comments are outside the diff and can’t be posted inline due to GitHub limitations. > > **⚠️ Outside diff range comments (3)** > >
> 🟠 Major · Define one revisioned refusal result for all state… · cephalon-physical-kernel-abi.edn:53-59
> > `docs/plans/cephalon-physical-kernel-abi.edn:53-59` > **🗄️ Data Integrity & Integration** | **🟠 Major** | **⚡ Quick win** > > **Define one revisioned refusal result for all state transitions.** > > The plan requires `admit-state`, `advance`, and `catch-up` to preserve the prior state when they refuse. It also requires explicit revisioned reasons for invalid elapsed time, unsafe arithmetic, and overflow. The ABI cannot represent this contract: `admit-state` has no prior-state input, while `advance` and `catch-up` expose no refusal output or reason field. > > Use one shared state-transition result that carries either the operation result or the unchanged prior state plus a revisioned refusal reason. > >
> Suggested fix > > ```diff > + :state-transition-result > + {:success :operation-result > + :refusal {:state :unchanged-prior-state > + :reason [:invalid-elapsed-us :unsafe-arithmetic :overflow] > + :reason-revision 1}} > :functions > - {:admit-state {:input [:trusted-visible-projection :physical-configuration] > - :output [:admitted-state-or-unchanged-refusal]} > + {:admit-state {:input [:prior-state-or-empty > + :trusted-visible-projection :physical-configuration] > + :output [:state-transition-result]} > :advance {:input [:state :elapsed-us :ordered-boundary-events] > - :output [:state :observations :residual-us :backlog-us :completeness]} > + :output [:state-transition-result]} > :catch-up {:input [:state] > - :output [:state :observations :residual-us :backlog-us :completeness] > + :output [:state-transition-result] > :new-elapsed-time :none :max-substeps 100}} > ``` > >
> >

Fix > only still-valid issues, skip the rest with a brief reason, keep changes > minimal, and validate. > > Review comment at @docs/plans/cephalon-physical-kernel-abi.edn around lines 53 - > 59: > Update the ABI definitions for admit-state, advance, and catch-up to use one > shared revisioned state-transition result. Include the unchanged prior state and > a revisioned refusal reason for invalid elapsed time, unsafe arithmetic, or > overflow; add prior-state-or-empty to admit-state’s inputs so every transition > can preserve prior state on refusal. > ``` > >
> > > >
>
> 🟠 Major · Declare catch-up replay semantics in the ABI. · cephalon-physical-kernel-abi.edn:57-59
> > `docs/plans/cephalon-physical-kernel-abi.edn:57-59` > **🎯 Functional Correctness** | **🟠 Major** | **⚡ Quick win** > > **Declare catch-up replay semantics in the ABI.** > > The plan requires `catch-up` to drain existing backlog and reproduce the recorded quantum/event schedule. The ABI only declares generic state and observation outputs. An implementation can therefore satisfy the declared function shape while leaving backlog unprocessed or using a different schedule. Replay can then produce different state, observations, event order, contacts, paths, or byte hashes. > >
> Suggested fix > > ```diff > :catch-up {:input [:state] > :output [:state :observations :residual-us :backlog-us :completeness] > - :new-elapsed-time :none :max-substeps 100} > + :new-elapsed-time :none :max-substeps 100 > + :backlog :drain-existing-only > + :schedule :reproduce-recorded-quantum-and-event-schedule} > ``` > >
> >

> 🟡 Minor · Declare intent evidence and the force-counting… · cephalon-physical-kernel-abi.edn:20-40
> > `docs/plans/cephalon-physical-kernel-abi.edn:20-40` > **🎯 Functional Correctness** | **🟡 Minor** | **⚡ Quick win** > > **Declare intent evidence and the force-counting invariant in the ABI.** > > The ABI declares only generic `:intent`, `:contributions`, and `:provenance` fields. An implementation that conforms only to this ABI can omit the required authored, reply, pin, inspiration, and contradiction evidence. It can also represent the same force structurally and semantically, then count it twice. Add both requirements to the bond contract. > >
> Suggested fix > > ```diff > - :bond/required [:id :endpoints :intent :contributions :provenance] > + :bond/required [:id :endpoints :intent :contributions :provenance > + :evidence-kinds :force-invariant] > + :bond/evidence-kinds [:authored :reply :pin :inspiration :contradiction] > + :bond/force-invariant :structural-and-semantic-counted-once > ``` > >
